title: A2UI v0.10 Surface Envelope
description: Top-level envelope returned by GET /api/surfaces/{page_id} on a v0.4 chapter when ?schema=v0.9 / ?schema=v0.8 is NOT requested. Wire-compatible with v0.9 plus an optional `meta` block on each component (see spec/0.4/a2ui.md §10). See spec/0.4/a2ui.md §1.

SurfaceMeta.description: Optional v0.10 surface-level metadata. PR-C4 reserves two namespaces (density, target) plus a vendor-extension escape. Component-level meta.density (when present) overrides surface-level density for that component.

SurfaceDensity.description: Surface-level default density. Components without their own meta.density inherit this.

preferred.description: Default density for every component on the surface.

SurfaceTarget.description: Target form factor hint. Renderers MAY use this to bias layout decisions (e.g. tighter density on mobile).

formFactor.description: Target form factor the chapter is optimising the surface for.
